learning.title: TanStack Link injects an active className; pass activeProps={{}} through UI.Link
learning.trigger: A UI.Link wraps the TanStack Router Link in @bakery/ui.
learning.mistake: TanStack Link adds className "active" to the anchor of the current route. UI STYLE_PROPS forbids className, so the UI architecture check failed on an otherwise valid link.
learning.rule: Give UI.Link activeProps={{}} so the router injects nothing, and no className. Express current-route state with aria-current or a data-ui-* tag, not a class.

verification.requirement: pnpm lint and the UI architecture check pass, and the anchor of the current route carries no "active" class.
